scientificQuestion: Does MYSTIC VROOM variance reduction make the conventional reference internally stable and resolve its disagreement with the frozen ALIS result?

design.singleIntendedChange: mc_vroom changes from off to on; geometry, spectral domain, diagnostic nodes, atmosphere, albedo, aerosol, photon count per seed, and solver family remain unchanged.

comparators: frozen six-seed ALIS result from run 30777018904
frozen six-seed conventional reference with mc_vroom off from run 30777018904
requiredOutputs: all six complete VROOM reference spectra
comparison with frozen ALIS and frozen VROOM-off reference

decisionMeaning.VROOM_REFERENCE_STABLE_AND_AGREES_WITH_A: The VROOM reference satisfies the frozen internal-stability and cross-method agreement gates; the former reference discrepancy is attributed to underconvergence.
decisionMeaning.PERSISTENT_METHOD_DISCREPANCY: The VROOM reference is internally stable but still fails at least one frozen cross-method agreement gate against ALIS.
decisionMeaning.VROOM_REFERENCE_STILL_UNDERCONVERGED: VROOM does not make the reference internally stable at 160 million photons per seed; the next preregistered step is reference-only photon scaling.
decisionMeaning.INCONCLUSIVE: No earlier rule applies. No production or physical-validity conclusion is permitted.
